dialogs.about: 가벼운 손 부상 뒤에 딸과 보험 청구 서류를 살펴요

lines.en: Mom, how is your hand this morning?
lines.ko: 엄마, 오늘 아침에 손은 좀 어때요?

lines.en: Much better, thank you. It is fine now.
Good. I will help with your insurance claim.
Thank you. Does my policy cover a small injury?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 제 보험 증권이 작은 부상도 보장해요?

lines.en: Yes, the coverage is good for that.
I paid the premium last month.
I know. I saw the paper last week.
When do I have to renew it?
In autumn. I will tell you again then.
You are a great help. Thank you so much.

dialogs.about: 보험 창구에서 안내원에게 청구와 갱신을 물어요

lines.en: Hello. I want to make a claim, please.
Of course, Ma'am. What happened to you?
I fell in the kitchen last week.
I am sorry. Was your injury serious?
No, it was small. The doctor was kind that day.
lines.ko: 아니요, 가벼웠어요. 그날 의사 선생님이 친절했어요.

lines.en: Good. Your policy covers this, so don't worry.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 보험 증권이 보장하니 걱정 마세요.

lines.en: Is my daughter a dependent on my policy?
No, but she has her own benefit.
I see. When should I renew this?
Next spring. I will call you before then.
